subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on November 15th, 2021. Your reservation code is XYZ123. Please review the attached itinerary for all the details of your flight. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
